stock.description: Headquartered in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China, JY Grandmark Holdings Limited is an investment holding company primarily focused on real estate development throughout the country. Established in 2013, its diverse operations span four key areas: residential property development and sales, investment in commercial real estate, hotel management, and various property services. The company is actively involved in constructing new residential projects, owning and operating commercial properties, and managing hotels under brands such as Just Stay Hotel and Just Stay Resort. Furthermore, JY Grandmark provides property and health management solutions, and participates in building decoration and general construction development. The company functions as a subsidiary of IQ EQ (BVI) Limited.
